verses.saheeh: Woe to every scorner and mocker
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe (waylun: an expression implying chastisement) to every backbiter, [who is a] slanderer, frequently engaging in backbiting and slander, that is to say, defamation — this was revealed regarding those who slandered the Prophet (s) and the believers, the likes of Umayya b. Khalaf, al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra and others —
verses.romanUrdu: Tabahi hai har us shaks ke liye jo (moonh dar moonh) logon par taan aur (peeth peechey) buraiyan karne ka khugar hai

verses.saheeh: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
verses.khattab: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who amasses (read jama‘a or jamma‘a) wealth and counts it over, keeping count of it and stores it aside as a provision against the [unforeseeable] calamities of time.
verses.romanUrdu: Jisne maal jama kiya aur usey gin gin kar rakkha

verses.saheeh: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
verses.khattab: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He thinks, in his ignorance, that his wealth will make him immortal, never to die.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh samajhta hai ke us ka maal hamesha uske paas rahega

verses.saheeh: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
verses.khattab: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay! — a repudiation — He will surely be flung (la-yunbadhanna is the response to an omitted oath), that is, he will be hurled down, into the Crusher, that crushes everything that is thrown into it.
verses.romanUrdu: Hargiz nahin, woh shaks to chakna-chur kar dene wali jagah mein phenk diya jayega

verses.saheeh: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
verses.khattab: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And what will show you, [what] will make known to you, what the Crusher is?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tum kya jano ke kya hai woh chakna-chur kar dene wali jagah

verses.saheeh: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
verses.jalalayn: ﻿[It is] the fire of God, kindled, set ablaze,
verses.romanUrdu: Allah ki aag khoob bhadkayi hui

verses.saheeh: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
verses.jalalayn: ﻿which peers over the hearts, to burn them — the pain of which is much more severe than any other because of the delicate nature [of the heart].

verses.saheeh: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
verses.khattab: It will be sealed over them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lo! it will be closed in (mu’sada or mūsada) on them (‘alayhim, ‘on them’: the plural pronoun takes into account the [plural] import of kull, ‘every’),
verses.romanUrdu: Woh un par dhaank kar bandh kar di jayegi

verses.jalalayn: ﻿in outstretched (mumaddadatin is an adjective qualifying the preceding [noun, ‘amadin]) columns (read ‘umudin or ‘amadin), and will therefore be inside the columns.
verses.romanUrdu: (Is halat mei ke woh) unchey unchey sutuno mei (ghirey huey hongey)
